sa: तदागच्छ वरारोहे तारितस्ते पिता सुतैः। चत्वारश्चैव राजानस्तथा चाहं सुमध्यमे॥
en: Therefore do you come, O you of beautiful hips, your father has obtained salvation by your sons and also the four kings (their fathers) and so also have been I, O you of slender waist."

sa: श्रद्दधनेन दूतेन भाषितं धर्मसंहितम्। पूर्वस्थास्त्रिदशाः सर्वे पितरः पूज्य खेचरम्॥
en: After the celestial messenger had said these words connected with virtue and duty, the celestials who were seated towards the east and the departed Manes also, praising that ranger of the sky, began as follows:

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्रोपायं प्रवक्ष्यामि यथावच्छास्त्रचक्षुषा। तत्त्वज्ञानाच्चरन् राजन् प्राप्नुयात्परमां गतिम्॥
en: 'I shall now describe to you the means of conquering the senses as seen with the eye of the scriptures. A person, O king, will attain to the highest and by shaping his conduct accordingly.

sa: ततोऽस्तं भास्करे याते संध्याकाल उपस्थिते। आजगाम स्वभवनं ब्रह्मलोकात् खगोत्तमः॥
en: When the shining luminary entered his chambers in the west and the evening twilight came, a bird that was the best of his species, returned there, which was his home, from the regions of Brahinan.

sa: पश्य सीतापदेशेन साक्षाद् वैवस्वतो यमः। इंग देशमनुप्राप्ते वानराणां विपत्तये॥
en: Behold! through Sita's simplicity* this onethe very son of the Sun, Yama-has come to this place, to exterminate the monkeys. *Another reading is Gridhra padesana— through the vultur's cunning. This the commentator consider as preferrable.

sa: ताविमौ शोकसंतप्तौ शनैः प्रेरय भामिनि। त्वया परिगृहीतोऽयमङ्गदः शास्तु मेदिनीम्॥
en: Do you soon despatch, O passionate lady, these two (Angada and Sugrīva) exercised with grief as they are (for the performance of Vali's funeral rites). And abiding by your commandments let Angada govern the earth.

sa: इष्टिं तेऽहं करिष्यामि पुत्रीयां पुत्रकारणात्। अथर्वशिरसि प्रोक्तैर्मन्त्रैः सिद्धां विधानतः॥
en: On your behalf, and with the view of obtaining sons for you, I will by help of mantras laid down in the Atharva Veda, duly celebrate the famous ceremony, capable of crowning you with offspring.

sa: सर्वदाभिगतः सद्भिः समुद्र इव सिन्धुभिः। आर्यः सर्वसमश्चैव सदैव प्रियदर्शनः॥
en: Ever resorted to by the good persons even as the ocean is by the rivers; worthy of being honoured; having an equal regard for all; and capable of filling the heart with ever new sensations.

sa: तमब्रवीद् दीप्तविशाललोचनं प्रदर्शयित्वा भयलोभमोहिता। सुदारुणं वाक्यमभीतचारिणी महात्मना शूर्पणखा विरूपिता॥
en: And transported with fear and desire, Śūrpanakhā, given to fearlessly ranging every where, who had been deformed by that highsouled one, showing (her mutilation), addressed these harsh words to Rāvana of flaming and expansive eyes.

sa: र्जानामि कार्यस्य च कालसङ्गम्। स्तच्चापि जानामि यदत्र कार्यम् ॥
en: I know the cause of the) wrath of that heroic monkey's friend. I know the time for action. I know what you had done for us. I know what is due from us to you.

sa: येन कालेन रामश्च वनात् प्रत्यगमिष्यति। अन्तर्बहिश्च पुत्रस्ते कृतमूलो भविष्यति॥
en: By the time that Rāma returns from the forest, your son, your prudent son along with his friends, securing the hearts of the people externally and internally, will have been firmly established on the throne.

sa: तृप्तिराश्चर्यभूतानां कथानां नास्ति मे विभो। कर्मकालो मुनिश्रेष्ठ लम्बते रविमण्डलम्॥
en: O Kusika's son. I never, O lord, am tired of listening to that wonderful narration. Now, O foremost of ascetics, the hour for performing the daily devotions has arrived, and the solar disc hangs aslope.

sa: अङ्गरागोचितां सीतां रक्तचन्दनसेविनीम्। 'वर्षमुष्णं च शीतं च नेष्यत्याशु विवर्णताम्॥
en: Now summer's heat and winter's cold and the rains of the wet season wil speedily stain Sītā, whose person is worthy of being dyed, and who used to daub her limbs with red sandal paste.

sa: कपिः कथयते हृष्टो यथायं मारुतात्मजः। कृत्यवान्सोऽपि सम्प्राप्तः कृतकृत्योऽसि राघव॥
en: From the glad way in which this son of the god of the wind is speaking, it appears that he also seeks your service; and, arriving (at this region) you also, Rāghava, have reaped success.

sa: गृहीतश्चैव पृष्ठश्च काले दृष्टः सकारण:। कच्चिन्न मुच्यते चोरो धनलोभानरर्षभ॥
en: And, O best of men, is a thief, that has been caught, interrogated (as to his guilt), and found with the stolen property on his person, set free (by your men) from motives of gain.

sa: पदाति सानुजं दृष्ट्वा ससीतं च जनास्तदा। ऊचुर्बहुजना वाचः शोकोपहतचेतसः॥
en: And deprived of their senses by grief, the multitudes,* beholding Rāma proceeding on foot in company with Sītā and his younger brother, said. *Another reading i.e., Beholding Rāma without his umbrella and walking a foot.

sa: हस्त्यश्वरथसम्बाधे युद्धे शस्त्रसमाकुले। मास्म कार्षीत् सतां धर्म यस्यार्योऽनुमते गतः॥
en: May he that had approved the exile into the woods of the noble one, never discharge the duty of the good in the field thronged with elephants and horses and cars, and bristling with arms!

sa: नाभिनन्देत मरणं नाभिनन्देत जीवितम्। कालमेघ प्रतीक्षते निदेशं भृतको यथा॥
en: One following the last mode of life should not regard death with joy. Nor should he regard life with joy. He should only wait for his hour like a servant waiting for his master's command.

sa: राक्षसोऽस्य विरूपाक्षः सूतो दीप्तास्यकुण्डलः॥ रश्मिभिः सूर्यरश्म्याभैः संजग्राह हयान् रणे।
en: A Rakshasa of frightful eyes and decked with bright ear-rings and possessing a fierce mouth acted as his charioteer, checking the horses by the rains that were as bright as the rays of the sun.

sa: धुर्यान् धुर्यगतान् सूतान ध्वजाश्चापानि सायकान्। पाणीन् सरत्नानसकृद भल्लैश्चिच्छेद पाण्डवः॥
en: The son of Pandu, again and again, cut-off with his broad-faced arrows the horses and horsemen, the drivers of cars and standards, bows and arrows, as well as arms, that were ornamented with valuable jewels.

sa: दान्तान् वेदव्रतस्नातान् स्नातानवभृथेषु च। सहस्रानुचरान् सौरान् सहस्रं चाप्ट चापरान्॥
en: They were all self-restrained and had performed ablutions after the accomplishment of sacrifices, vows and recital of the Vedas. Worshippers of the sun, they counted a thousand in number with one thousand and eight followers.

sa: ततः प्रदीपिते देवैः पार्थतेजसि पार्थिव। तस्थावचलवद् धीमान् संग्रामे परमास्त्रवित्॥
en: When at last the energy of Partha blazed forth through those deeds of the dwellers of the celestial region, that hero, who was conversant with celestial weapons of great efficacy, stood immovable like a hill.

sa: अश्वत्थाम्नः शरानस्तान् छित्त्वैकैकं त्रिधा त्रिधा। व्यधमद् भरतश्रेष्ठो नीहारमिव मारुतः॥
en: The most excellent of the Bharata race, after having severed every one of the shafts of Ashvatthaman into three pieces, destroyed the power of those arrows even as the sun does away with the mist.

sa: समुद्यम्य महाबाहूर्धामयामास वीर्यवान्। ततो मल्लाच मत्स्याश्चं विस्मयं चक्रिरे परम्॥
en: Then the mighty-armed Bhima of great prowess raised him up and began to whirl him round; then all the athlete and the people of the Matsya's, who had assembled on the occasion, were greatly astonished.

sa: सांख्यदर्शनमेतत् ते परिसंख्यानमुत्तमम्। एवं हि परिसंख्याय सांख्याः केवलतां गताः॥
en: I have thus told you the philosophy of the Sankhyas, that excellent science by which all things have been correctly determined. Ascertaining the nature of Soul and Nature in this way, the Sankhyas acquire Liberation.

sa: तं वेदाश्चाश्रमाश्चैव नानामतसमास्थिताः। भक्त्या सम्पूजयन्त्याशु गतिं चैषां ददाति सः॥
en: The Vedas and all the modes of life, though marked by diversities of opinion, all adore Him with devotion. It is he who, inclined to show favour, confers on them high ends fraught with happiness.

sa: अर्थानामननुष्ठाता कामचारी विकत्यनः। अपि सर्वां महीं लब्ध्वा क्षिप्रमेव विनश्यति॥
en: That king who cannot satisfy his royal duties, who is governed by caprice in all his acts, and who vaunts, soon meets with destruction even if he happen to be the king of whole Earth.

sa: अस्तायुधं पाण्डवेयावशिष्टं न यद् वहेच्छकटं षड्गवीयम्। एतद् विद्वन् मुञ्च सहस्रशोऽपि गदासिबाहुद्रविणं च तेऽस्ति॥ प्रासाश्च मुद्गरा शक्तयस्तोमराश्च मा भैषीस्त्वं सङ्ख्यादायुधानाम्॥
en: To speak candidly, O son of Pandu, the quantity that is still left is quite unmanageable even by half-a-dozen bullocks, if placed on carts. O skillful one, throw off your weapons in no measured number, for your maces, swords and scimitars, as also your lances darts and spears and other weapons of the arms, number thousands upon thousands. So be of good cheer and pray do not be misapprehensive of your weapons running short."

sa: मां चेदभ्यागतः कालो दानवेश्वरपूजितम्। गर्जन्तं प्रतपन्तं च कमन्यं नागमिष्यति॥
en: I was the adored king of the Danavas. Consuming all with my energy, I used to roar in strength and pride. When Time has attacked even myself, who is there whom he will not attack.

sa: कालानलसमं पार्थ ज्वलनार्कविषोपमम्। भीमं द्रोणशिरश्छिन्नं न प्रशंससि मे कथम्॥
en: ) Partha, I have lopped off Drona's dreadful head, resembling the All-destroying Fire or the burning Sun or the most virulent poison. Why do you not then applaud an act that is worthy of applause?

sa: वैश्यानां धान्यधनवाञ्छूद्राणामेव जन्मतः। पूज्यतायां च गोविन्दे हेतू द्वावपि संस्थितौ॥
en: Amongst Vaishyas, he, who is rich in possessions and wealth; and amongst the Shudras he, who is old in age, deserves to be worshipped. There are two reasons for offering the worship to Govinda (Krishna).

sa: स्वधर्मं नेच्छसे ज्ञातुं मिथ्यावचनमेव ते। भयार्दितानामस्माकं वाचा मर्माणि कृन्तसि॥
en: You are now seeking virtue. So you have falsified the words you had said before. Afflicted as we are with fear, you take this opportunity for cutting us to the quick with your harsh words.

sa: दन्तैः शुकैः शिखरिभिः सिंहसंहननो महान्। चक्राङ्कितकरः श्रीमान् महामूर्धा महाबलः॥
en: The boy was gifted with sharp, strong and pearly teeth; he was strong enough to kill lions, he had all auspicious signs on his palms, he had a broad forehead, he was beautiful and strong.

sa: कुम्भकर्णशिरो भाति कुण्डलालंकृतं महत्। आदित्येऽभ्युदिते रात्रौ मध्यस्थ इव चन्द्रमाः॥
en: Then Kumbhakarņa's huge head deprived of the ear-rings appeared like the Moon seated in the midst of the heavens) on the rising of the Sun in the morning.* *This Sloka is wanting in many texts.

sa: हंसवद् विदुषां राजन् द्विजानां तत्र भारती। शुश्रुवे वेदविदुषां पुष्कलार्थपदाक्षरा॥
en: The king heard that sound uttered by those learned Brahmanas loud and clear like the sound of swans. He listened also to the melodious and significant speeches, of those persons well read in the Vedas.

sa: अस्त्रैरभेद्यः शस्त्रैश्चाप्यधः कायश्च तेऽनघ। कृतः पुष्पमयो देव्या रूपतः स्त्रीमनोहरः॥
en: On sinless one, therefore it is invincible to weapons of every description. The lower part of your body, capable of captivating the female heart by its comeliness, was made of flowers by the goddess herself.

sa: पन्थानो ब्रह्मणस्त्वेते एतैः प्राप्नोति यत्परम्। तद् विद्वाननुबुद्ध्येत मनसा कर्मनिश्चयम्॥
en: These form the path of Brahma. By those one acquires the Highest. A wise man when he acquires these qualities, understands that the cure of all defects of the heart is the result of acts.

sa: लक्ष्मणस्य च नाराचा बहवः सन्ति तद्विधाः। वज्राशनिसमस्पर्शा गिरीणामपि दारकाः॥
en: Lakşmaņa has many an iron arrow like Indra's thunderbolt or that of the sky,* capable of riving even mountains. 15 *Vajrasani-Vajra is the thunder-bolt in the hand of Indra, and Asani—the thunder-bolt produced by clouds.

sa: अत्र वै हिमवत्पृष्ठे नित्यमास्ते महेश्वरः। प्रकृत्या पुरुषः सार्धं युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः॥
en: Here on the breast of the Himayat mountain even lives Maheshvara who is endued with effulgence like that of the fire which blazes at the termination of each Yuga, like Purusha in company with Prakriti.

sa: अस्यां दिशि वरिष्ठायामुत्तरायां द्विजर्षभ। नासौम्यो नाविधेयात्मा नाधर्मो वसते जनः॥
en: In this region, the north, which is the best, O best among the twice born, none that is not tranquil, none that has not brought his soul under control and none that is vicious, lives.

sa: को हि ब्राह्मणमाचार्यमभिदुह्येत मादृशः। ऋषिपुत्रो ममाचार्यो द्रोणस्य परमः सखा।॥
en: (For) is there any body, who is, like me, hostile to a Brahmana who is his preceptor as well? He is (moreover) the son of a sage, my preceptor and the dear friend of Drona.

sa: यदा पश्यति भूतानि प्रसन्नात्माऽऽत्मनो हृदि। स्वयंज्योतिस्तदा सूक्ष्मात् सूक्ष्मं प्रन्पोत्यनुत्तमम्॥
en: When one with a tranquil soul sees all entities in his own heart, then, lighted by his own effulgence, one attains to that which is subtler than the subtle and which is peerless in excellence.

sa: तं स शालचयं श्रीमत् सप्रतोलीसुघट्टितम्। मापयामास कौरव्यो यज्ञवाट यथाविधि॥
en: Bhima selected a beautiful place and caused it to be duły measured out for laying the sacrificial compound. Numberless houses and mansions were constructed on it and high and broad roads also were laid cut.

sa: पुत्रशोकमनुप्राप्त एष रैभ्यस्य कर्मणा। त्यक्ष्यामि त्वामृते पुत्र प्राणानिष्टतमान् भुवि॥
en: I have been afflicted with the grief at my son's death on account of Raivya. O son, for your death I shall give up my life which is the most precious thing in the world.

sa: द्यूतेऽद्वितीयः शकुनि रेषु कुन्तीसुतस्तेन निसृष्टकामः। स्तस्मान्न ते प्रश्नमिमं ब्रवीमि॥
en: Shakuni is matchless in dice. The son of Kunti has still willfully staked with him. The illustrious (Yudhisthira) does not consider that Shakuni played with him deceitfully. Therefore, I am unable to decide this matter.

sa: आचार्यमृत्विजं चैव संयुजं च युधिष्ठिर। स्नातकं च प्रियं प्राहुः षडार्हान् नृपं तथा॥ एतानानभिगतानाहुः संवत्सरोषितान्। त इमे कालपूगस्य महतोऽस्मानुपागताः॥
en: O Yudhishthira, hear, the preceptor, the sacrificial priest, the relative,, the Snataka, the friend and the king, these are the six (classes of persons) who deserve to get the Arghya. The wise men have said that when any of there live with one for a full one year, he deserves to be worshipped with the presentation of Arghya. These kings have been staying with us for a very long time,

sa: स तत्र तामङ्घयधनुर्धरस्य वेदी ददर्शायतपीनबाहुः। ऋचीकपुत्रस्य तपस्विसङ्घः समावृतां पुण्यकृदर्चनीयाम्॥
en: The long and lusty-armed hero saw the celebrated altar of Rechika's son, that foremost of all wielders of the bow. It was surrounded by many ascetics and was fit to be worshipped by the virtuous..

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ततोऽहं भरतश्रेष्ठ प्रगृह्य रुचिरंधनुः। शरैरपातयं सौभाच्छिरांसि विबुधद्विषाम्॥
en: Krishna said : O best of the Bharata race, then taking up my beautiful bow, I began to cut off with my arrows the heads of the enemies of the celestials from the (car) Saubha.

sa: एको भर्ता स्त्रिया देवैर्विहितः कुरुनन्दन। इयं त्वनेकवशगा बन्धकीति विनिश्चिता॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, it has been ordained by the gods that a woman should have only one husband; she (Draupadi) has (however) many husbands; therefore it is certain that she is an unchaste woman.

sa: गङ्गायास्तत्र राजेन्द्र सागरस्य च संगमे। अश्वमेधं दशगुणं प्रवदन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: O king of kings, it has been said by the wise men that he who goes to the place where the Ganges has joined the sea, one obtains ten times the merit of Ashvamedha sacrifice.

sa: ब्राह्मणा वाटधानाश्च गोमन्तः शतसङ्घशः। त्रिखर्वं बलिमादाय द्वारि तिष्ठन्ति वारिताः॥
en: Being stopped there by the gatekeepers hundreds of Brahmanas, supported by the land presented to them (by Yudhishthira) and possessing wealth of kine, waited at the palace gate with three thousands of millions of tribute.

sa: सरस्वती नदी सद्भिः सततं पार्थ पूजिता। बालखिल्यैर्महाराज यत्रेष्टमृषिभिः पुरा॥
en: O son of Pritha, O great king, here is also the river Sarasvati which is ever worshipped by the pious and (on the bank of which) the Balkhilayas performed sacrifices in the days of yore.

sa: अर्थत्यागोऽपि कार्यः स्यादर्थं श्रेयांसमिच्छता। बीजौपम्येन कौन्तेय मा भूदन्न संशयः॥
en: O son of Kunti, wealth should be spent in the way that seeds are scattered on the ground by one who wishes to increase it. Let there be no doubt (about it) in your mind.

sa: दक्षिणार्थं समानीता राजभिः कांस्यदोहनाः। आरण्या बहुसाहस्रा अपश्यंस्तत्र तत्र गाः॥
en: As I saw many thousands of wild kine with as many vessels of white copper for milking them, brought there by the kings of the earth to be given away Dakshina (sacrificial presents) by Yudhishthira.

sa: राज्यस्य पदवीधयां व्रज सत्पुरुषोचिताम्। धर्मकामार्थहीनानां किं नो वस्तुं तपोवने॥
en: Bhima said: O king, walk as regards kingdoms in the customary path trodden by good men. What do you gain by living in the hermitage of the ascetics, thus deprived of Dharma, Artha and Kama?

sa: जलेचरः काञ्चयष्टिसंस्थो व्यात्ताननः सर्वतिमिप्रमाथी। वित्रासयन् राजति वाहमुख्ये शाल्वस्य सेनाप्रमुखध्वजावयः॥
en: The aquatic creature (Makara), that devourer of all fishes, which was on the golden flag-staff of that best of cars with wide-opened mouth, struck terror into the hearts of all the warriors of (king) Shalva.

sa: यदि मां सिंहविक्रान्तो मत्तवारणविक्रमः। नाभिगच्छति राजेन्द्रो विनइक्ष्यामि न संशयः॥
en: If that foremost of kings, of prowess like that of a lion and of courage like that of a furious elephant, do not come to me, there will be no doubt that I will die.

sa: अपि प्रत्यक्षमेवैतत् तव देव शतक्रतो। अकुलानां समृद्धानां कथं कुलविपर्ययः॥
en: O deity Shatakratu, those that have no family dignity gain wealth, what could be greater reverses of family dignity than this? All this you are to see happening before yours eyes (if your live forever).

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु वैदा नलस्तां प्रत्युवाच हा तिष्ठत्सु लोकपालेषु कथं मानुषमिच्छसि॥
en: Thus addressed by the daughter of the king of the Vidharbhas, Nala said to her in reply: “How is it that you choose a man rejecting the Lokapalas (guardians of the worlds) who are present?

sa: अथ काले तु सा ब्रह्मन्प्रजज्ञे भुजगस्वसा। कुमारं देवगर्भाभं पितृमातृभयापहम्॥
en: O Brahmana, the sister of the snake in due time gave birth to a son with the splendour of a celestial boy, the destroyer of the fears of (the relatives of) his father and mother.

sa: समारम्भो न क्योऽयमन्यथा कुरुनन्दन। राजसूयश्च कात्स्येंन कर्तुं मतिमतां वर॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O foremost of all intelligent men, if you do not try to do it, your undertaking can never be successful. If you wish to perform Rajasuya (sacrifice), you must do it.

sa: तथैव दुर्गसंस्कारं देवैरपि दुरासदम्। स्त्रियोऽपि यस्यां युध्येयुः किमु वृष्णिमहारथाः॥
en: We repaired its fort and made it so strong that it became impregnable even to the celestialss. Even women could fight from within it, not to speak of the great car-warriors of the Vrishni race.

sa: भिक्षुः सर्वार्थसिद्धश्च ब्राह्मणावसथे वसन्॥ तेन दत्तः प्रहारो मे निष्कारणमनागसः।
en: In the house of a certain Brāhmaṇa there lives a': beggar by the name of Sarvārthasiddha (i.e., who has got all his desires satisfied). And although I am innocent, he has for nothing hurt me.

sa: कालातिक्रमणादेते भक्तवेतनयो ताः। भर्तुः कुप्यन्ति यद्धृत्याः सोऽनर्थः सुमहान् स्मृतः॥
en: Are you aware that the misery caused by the arrears of pay and the irregularity of the issue of rations creates mutiny amongst the soldiers? The learned men call it the greatest of all mischief.

sa: सा च दृष्ट्वैव राजानं विचरन्तं महाद्युतिम्। स्नेहादागतसौहार्दा नातृष्यत विलासिनी॥
en: The maiden also, seeing that king of great effulgence move about in great agitation, was moved and felt for him an affection and friendship. She gazed at him and longed to gaze at him more.

sa: च्यवनं दीप्ततपसं धर्मात्मानं यशस्विनम्। यः स रोषाच्च्युतो गर्भान्मातुर्मोक्षाय भारत॥
en: Named Chyavana, who was greatly famous, very virtuous minded and as effulgent as the sun. O descendant of the Bharata race, he came out of his mother's womb in anger and thus released his mother.

sa: य इदं श्रावयेद्विद्वान्ब्राह्मणानिह पर्वसु। धूतपाप्मा जितस्वर्गो ब्रह्म गच्छति शाश्वतम्॥
en: The learned man, who recites it to Brahmanas during the sacred Parvas (lunar changes), is cleansed of all his sins and being victorious over heaven (not caring for it) attains to an union with Brahma.

sa: वसामेदोवहाः कुल्या नागानां संप्रवर्तिताः। ववौ गन्धश्च तुमुलो दह्यतामनिशं तदा॥
en: The fat and the marrow of the snakes, thus burnt in the sacrificial fire, flowed like rivers and the whole atmosphere was filled with an insufferable stench, owing to this continual burning of the snakes.

sa: न स तं प्रतिजग्राह नैषादिरिति चिन्तयन्। शिष्यं धनुषि धर्मज्ञस्तेषामेवान्ववेक्षया॥
en: That learned man in all the precepts of religion (Drona) did not accept him (the Nishada prince) as his pupil in archery, thinking that he was a Nishada and considering the interest of the princes.

sa: किं पुनर्धर्मशीलस्य मम वा मद्विधस्य वा। एवमुक्ता जरत्कारुर्भ; हृदयकम्पनम्॥
en: Far less can remain a man like me, who am religious and those who are like me. Being thus addressed by her husband, the heart of the sister of Vasuki began to tremble (in fear).

sa: गंभीरं तिमिमकरोग्रसंकुलं तं। गर्जन्त जलचररावरौद्रनादैः। विस्तीर्णं ददृशतुरम्बरप्रकाशं तेऽगाधं निधिमुरुमम्भसामनन्तम्॥
en: They saw that it was deep and resounded with the terrible uproar of Makaras Timis and other aquatic creatures; they saw it was vast, unlimited as space, unfathomable, infinite and the great reservoir of waters.

sa: स चापि द्विरदश्रेष्ठः सदाऽप्रतिगजो युधि। सर्वशस्त्रातिग: संख्ये कृतकर्मा जितक्लमः॥
en: His elephant is also the foremost of the species, whom no rival dares encounter in battle; the animal is well accomplished in all tactics and indefatigable and beyond the reach of all weapons in battle.

sa: युद्धकाले त्वयाऽस्माकं साह्यं देयमिति प्रभो। बाढमित्येवमुक्त्वा तु युद्धकाल इहागतः॥
en: 'O son, when the battle would take place, you should render us assistance. He then said 'yea' to the words of his father; and now that the hour has arrived, he also presented himself, Son

sa: ततः सुनाभं वसुदेवपुत्रः सूर्यप्रभं वज्रसमप्रभावम्। क्षुरान्तमुद्यम्य भुजेन चक्र रथादवप्लुत्य विसृज्य वाहान्॥ संकम्पयन् गां चरणैर्महात्मा वेगेन कृष्णः प्रससार भीष्मम्।
en: Having said this, the son of Vasudeva threw off the reins of the horses and jumped down from the car. Whirling with his right arm his discus with a beautiful shape and with sharpness as that of a razors, which was as effulgent as the sun and possessed the force of one thousand thunderbolts, the high-souled Krishna rushed with great force towards Bhishma making the earth tremble under his feet.

sa: रणे तस्मिन् सुमहति विजयस्य सुतस्य ते। विसिस्मापयिषुर्लोकान् विद्यया ब्रह्मवित्तमः॥
en: In that dreadful battle, that foremost of persons conversant with the knowledge of the Vedas, was desirous of bestowing victory on your son and of exciting the wonder of the worlds with his excellent learning.

sa: एवमेष महाराज स्त्रीपुमान् दुपदात्मजः। स सम्भूतः कुरुश्रेष्ठ शिखण्डी रथसत्तमः॥
en: In this way it is, O great king, that the son of Drupada is both a man and woman, and he was born as Shikhandin, O best of Kurus, and as the best of car-warriors.

sa: सोऽन्यत् कार्मुकमादाय शत्रुजं भारसाधनम्। द्रौणि षष्ट्या महाराज बाह्वोरुरसि चार्पयत्।॥
en: Then taking up another capable of slaying the foe and of bearing great stream, Satyaki pierced the son of Drona on the breast and on the arms with a group of sixty shafts, O king.

sa: ते समेत्य यथान्यायं धार्तराष्ट्रा महाबलाः। कुरुक्षेत्रस्य पश्चार्धे व्यवातिष्ठन्त दंशिताः॥
en: And these followers of the great and mighty son of Dhritarashtra, uniting together according to the proper mode took up their station, all clad in Armour, on the back part of the plains of Kurukshetra.

sa: तस्मात् स्वर्गगतं पुत्रमर्जुनस्य हतं रणे। न चेहानयितुं शक्यं किंचिदप्राप्यमीहितम्॥
en: Therefore it is not easy to find out any desirable thing that might have been unattained by him, that might bring back into this world Arjuna's son slain in battle and now dwelling in heaven.

sa: अशुश्रुम भृशं चास्य शक्रस्येवाभिगर्जतः। सुघोरं तलयोः शब्दं निघ्नतस्तव वाहिनीम्॥
en: While he was slaying the warriors of your army, we heard shouts that resembled those of Indra himself, uttered by Arjuna, as also the dreadful sounds he produced by striking his palms against his arms.

sa: सूतश्च मातरिश्वा वै कवचं वेदमातरः। सुसंवीतो रणे ताभिर्योत्स्येऽहं कुरुनन्दन॥
en: The wind is my driver, and the mothers of the Vedas (Gayatri, Savitri and Sarasvati) constitute my coat of mail. Well protected by these, in battle, I shall fight, O you delighter of the Kurus."

sa: अस्त्राणीन्द्राच्च रुद्राच्च भूयः स समवाप्तवान्। अमर्षितश्च ते राजंस्ततो नामर्षयाम्यहम्॥
en: Moreover, he has obtained weapons from Indra and Rudra; besides he has been, O king, incensed by you. It is for these reasons, that I venture not to perform what you ask me to do.

sa: तपस्विभ्योऽधिको योगी ज्ञानिभ्योऽपि मतोऽधिकः। कर्मिभ्यश्चाधिको योगी तस्माद् योगी भवार्जुन॥
en: The Yogi is considered to be superior to the ascetics who perform penances, superior even to a man of true knowledge, he is higher than the men of action. Therefore, ( Arjuna, become a Yogi.

sa: शासिताम्यद्य ते बाणैः सर्वसैन्यस्य पश्यतः। अद्याहमनृणस्तस्य कोपस्त भविता रणे॥
en: This day I will free myself from the burden of anger I bear against you, as also from the debt I owe to my sires and to the angry Krishna, who ever desire your death.

sa: एष सेनाप्रणेतृणामेष शस्त्रभृतामपि। एष बुद्धिमतां चैव श्रेष्ठो राजन् गुरुस्तव॥
en: O monarch, this one is the foremost of all leaders of warriors; he is the foremost of all wielders of arms, as also of all intelligent persons and he is also your preceptor (in arms).

sa: ततो दौःशासनिः क्षिप्रं तथा तैर्विरथीकृतम्। संशयं परमं प्राप्य दिष्टान्तेनाभ्ययोजयत्॥
en: Thus when Abhimanyu was deprived of the use of his car by those warriors, Dushasana's son, who himself was involved in great catastrophe, succeeded, as fate would have it, in making Abhimanyu see his end.

sa: पतितानि न जानन्ति शिरांसि पुरुषर्षभाः। अमृष्यमाणाः संग्रामे कौन्तेयं जयगृद्धिनः॥
en: The (surviving) foremost of warriors, all resenting those feats of Arjuna, the son of Kunti and desirous of conquering him in battle, did not pay any regard to the fallen heads (of their brother warriors).

sa: येन भोजश्य हार्दिक्यो भवांश्च त्रिदशोपमः। अस्त्रप्रतापेन जितौ श्रुतायुश्च निबर्हितः॥
en: He by whom the son of Hridika, the ruler of the Bhojas and yourself equal to a god, have all been vanquished with the showers of his weapons, he by whom Shrutayusha has been slain.

sa: श्रेयान् द्रव्यमयाद् यज्ञाज्ज्ञानयज्ञः परंतप। सर्वं कर्माखिलं पार्थ ज्ञाने परिसमाप्यते॥
en: The sacrifice of knowledge, O terror of foes, is superior to the Sacrifice for gaining possession (in this world or in the future), for, O Parthas, all actions are wholly and fully comprehended by knowledge.

sa: हरितो रोहितो नीलः कृष्णो रक्तस्तथारुणः। कदुश्च कपिलश्चैव कपोतो मेचकस्तथा॥
en: You are Green, you are Red, you are Blue, you are Dark, You are of Bloody colour, you are of the colour of the Sun. You are Tawny, you are Brown, and you are Dark-blue.

sa: पिनाकिनं खड्गधरं लोकानां पतिमीश्वरम्॥ प्रपद्ये शरणं देवं शरण्यं चीरवाससम्। नमस्तस्मै सुरेशाय यस्य वैश्रवणः सखा॥ सुवाससे नमस्तुभ्यं सुव्रताय सुधन्विने।
en: Who use the bow Pinaka, who is shorn of his battle-axe and who is the sovereign and the saviour of the universe. I totally consign myself to the care of that divine lord, that giver of protection, that god versed in deer's skin; salutation to that lord of the gods who has Vaisravana for his friend, salutation to him of illustrious vows, to him whose companions are all best bow-men.

sa: आकाशगङ्गागतश्च पुरा भरद्वाजो महर्षिरुपास्पृशत् त्रीन् क्रमान् क्रमता विष्णुनाभ्यासादित: स भरद्वाजेन ससलिलेन पाणिनोरसि ताडितः सलक्षणोरस्कः संवृत्तः॥ भृगुणा महर्षिणा शप्तोऽग्निः सर्वभक्षत्वमुपानीतः॥
en: In days of yore, while the great Rishi Bharadvaja was saying his prayers by the side of the divine Ganga, one of the three feet of Vishnu, when he assumed his three-footed form, reached that place. Seeing that strange spectacle Bharadvaja attacked Vishnu with a handful of water, upon which Vishnu's bosom received a (mystic mark). Cursed by that foremost of Rishis, viz., Bhrigu, Agni was obliged to become a devourer of all things.

sa: प्रतिज्ञातं मया तावत् त्वयोक्तं देवि शृण्वता। रामं यदभिषेकाय त्वमिहागतमब्रवीः॥
en: O noble dame, having heard you asking for the banishment of Rāma, who had at first been intended by me for being installed, and who came here afterwards, I had promised you (his exile alone.)

sa: स्वस्ति वोऽस्तु गमिष्यामि सिद्धः सिद्धाश्रमादहम्। उत्तरे जाह्नवीतीरे हिमवन्तं शिलोच्चयम्॥
en: And on the eve of setting out, he addressed the sylvan deities, saying, Luck! I will, with my desire obtained, go from forth this Siddhāśrama to the Himavat mountain on the north of the Jahnavi.

sa: हिमवतो गिरेर्दुहितरमुमां कन्यां रुद्रश्चकमे भृगुरपि च महर्षिर्हिमवन्तमागत्याब्रवीत् कन्यामिमां मे देहीति तमब्रवीद्धिमवानभिलक्षितो वरो रुद्र इति तमब्रवीद् भृगुर्यस्मात् त्वयाहं कन्यावरणकृतभावः प्रत्याख्यातस्तस्मान्न रत्नानां भवान् भाजनं भविष्यतीति॥ अद्यप्रभृत्येतदवस्थितमृषिवचनं तदेवंविधं माहात्म्यं ब्राह्मणानाम्॥
en: The daughter, named Uma, of the Himavat mountains, was sought by Rudra in marriage. (Ater Himavat) had promised the hand of Uma to Mahadeva the great Rishi Bhrigu, approaching Himvat, said to him-Give this daughter of yours to in marriage!-Himavat replied to him-Rudra is the bridegroom already selected by me for my daughter!-Enraged at this reply, Bhrigu said-Since you refuse my suit for the hand of your daughter and insult me thus, you will no longer contain jewels and gems!—To this day, on account of the Rishi's words, the mountains of Himavat have not any jewels and gems. Such is the glory of the Brahmanas.

sa: तदग्र्यवेषप्रमदाजनाकुलं महेन्द्रवेश्मप्रतिमं निवेशनम्। व्यदीपयंश्चारु विवेश पार्थिवः शशीव तारागणसंकुलं नभः॥
en: Even as the moon illumines the firmament crowded with stars, the handsome king entered his mansion, like to the abode of the mighty Indra, and thronged with females excellently attired, gracing it (by his presence).

sa: येषु विप्रतिपद्यन्ते षट्सु मोहात् फलागमम्। तेष्वध्यवसिताध्यायी विन्दते ध्यानजं फलम्॥
en: Men are deceived by illusion in hoping to reap the fruit of those six things the effects of which are studied by persons of spiritual insight who thereby reap the fruits of their clear perception.

sa: तस्मिंस्तु तुमुले शब्दे भीरूणां भयवर्धने। अतीव हृष्टो दाशार्हमब्रवीत् पाकशासनिः॥
en: Thus when that tremendous din arose there din that enhanced the fear of the cowards the son of Pakashasani became filled with joy; and addressing the descendant of the Dasarha race, he then thus spoke.

sa: कृत्वा मानुष्यकं कर्म सृत्वाजिं यावदुत्तमम्। धर्मस्यानृण्यमाप्नोति न चात्मानं विगर्हते॥
en: Doing the deed of men and achieving every feat that is really great in a field of battle a man satisfied the duties of his order and has no reason to find fault with himself.

sa: ततो देवैर्ऋषिभिश्चापि कृष्णः समागतश्चारणैश्चैव राजन्। गन्धवौय्यैरप्सरोभिर्वराभिः सिद्धैः साध्यैश्चानतैः पूज्यमानः॥
en: Krishna then met the deities and (celestial) Rishis and Charanas, O king, and the foremost ones among the Gandharvas and many beautiful Apsaras and Siddhas and Saddhyas. All of them bending in humility, adored him.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तया प्रातिष्ठतोत्तङ्कः। पथि गच्छन्नपश्यदृषभमतिप्रमाणं तमधिरूढं पुरुषमतिप्रमाणमेव। स पुरुष उत्तङ्कमभ्यभाषत॥
en: Thus ordered, Uttanka took his departure.' When he was passing along the road he met with an extraordinary large bull and a man of extraordinary large stature riding on it. The man addressed Uttanka thus.

sa: अष्टौ प्रकृतयः प्रोक्ता विकाराश्चापि षोडश। तत्र तु प्रकृतीरष्टौ प्राहुरध्यात्मचिन्तकाः॥
en: Eight principles have been called by the name of Nature, while sixteen have been called changes. Of Manifest, there are seven. These are of views of those persons who are conversant with the spiritual science.

sa: किं पुनर्ब्राह्मणाः पार्थ क्षत्रिया वा बहुश्रुताः। स्वधर्मरतयो नित्यं ब्रह्मलोकपरायणाः॥
en: What need be said then, O son of Pritha, of Brahmanas and Kshatriyas endued with great learning, always devoted to the duties of their own orders, and who are intent on the region of Brahma?

sa: तस्याधर्मप्रवृत्तस्य हिंसकस्य दुरात्मनः। दानेन कीर्तिर्भवति न प्रेत्येह च दुर्मतेः॥
en: By the gifts made by a person of unrighteous conduct, one, that is, who is of sinful soul and who is a destroyer, just fame never acquired either in this world or in the next.

sa: एवंविधाश्च ये केचिल्लोकेऽस्मिन् पापकर्मिणः। मनुष्या भिन्नमर्यादास्ते सर्वे तामसाः स्मृताः॥
en: Whatever men there are in this world, who are characterised by these and other faults of a similar kind, and who break through the restraints are all considered as belonging is the quality of Ignorance.

sa: ददात्युदितमात्रे यस्तस्य पाप्मा विधूयते। मध्याह्ने ददतो रुक्मं हन्ति पापमनागतम्॥
en: The man who, as soon as the Sun has risen, makes a gift of gold becomes purged of all his sins. He who makes a gift of gold at midday destroys all his future sins.

sa: सा कृत्या कालरात्रीव कृताञ्जलिरुपस्थिता। वृषादी नरपतिं किं करोमाति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: That form which had originated from the incantations of the king, loO king as dreadful as the Last Night, appeared with joined hands before the king. Addressing king Vrishadarbhi, she said, What shall I do?

sa: कौमारं ब्रह्मचर्यं ते जानामि द्विजसत्तम। दुःखार्जितस्य तपसस्तस्मन्निच्छामि ते व्ययम्॥
en: O foremost of twice-born ones. I know that you have observed the rules of Brahmacharya from your infancy. I do not, therefore wish the loss or diminution of your penances acquired with so much pain!

sa: अल्पभोगकुले जाता अल्पभोगरता नराः। अनेन कर्मणा देवि भवन्त्यधनिनो नराः॥
en: Born in families which are destitute of all articles of enjoyment, these men never succeed in enjoying the goodly things of Earth. Indeed, O goddess, it is through deeds that persons become wretched and poor.

sa: पुत्राञ्छ्रियं च लभते यश्छत्रं सम्प्रयच्छति। न चक्षुर्व्याधिं लभते यज्ञभागमथाश्नुते॥
en: The man who makes a gift of an umbrella gets children and great prosperity. Such a person never suffers from any eyedisease. The merits also that originate from the performance of a sacrifice become his.

sa: यातुधान्युवाच यथोदाहृतमेतत्ते मयि नाम महाद्युते। दुर्धार्यमेतत् मनसा गच्छावतर पद्मिनीम्॥
en: Yatudhani said O you of great effulgence, the explanation you have given me of your name is incapable of being understood by me. Do you, therefore, go and plunge into this tank filled with lotuses.

sa: अधीत्याध्यापनं कुर्यात् तथा यजनयाजने। दानं प्रतिग्रहं वापि षड्गुणां वृत्तिमाचरेत्॥
en: Having studied, one should teach likewise should celebrate sacrifices himself and officiate at the sacrifices of others. One should also make gifts made to oneself. Indeed, one's conduct should be marked by these six deeds.

sa: श्रुत्वा च नावजानामि नापराध्यामि कर्हिचित्। अभ्याभ्यनुपृच्छामि पादौ गृह्णामि धीमताम्॥
en: Having heard their interpretations I never disregard them. Nor do I ever offend against the Brahmanas in any way. I always adore intelligent Brahmanas. I always seek information from them. I always adore their feet.

sa: तच्छ्रुत्वा विस्मयं जग्मुर्धृतराष्ट्रादयो नृपाः। सम्पूज्य मनसा कृष्णं सर्वे प्राञ्जलयोऽभवन्॥
en: All the kings with Dhritarashtra amongst thein become stricken with wonder upon hearing the words of the Kuru grandfather. In their minds they adored Krishna and then turned towards him with hands clasped in respect.

sa: पतितस्य तु भार्याया भर्ना सुसमवेतया। तथा दत्तकृतौ पुत्रावध्यूढच तथापरः॥
en: The son begotten upon his own wife by a person degraded from his positions is called Patitaja. There are two other, sons, viz., the son given, and the son made. There is another called Adhyuda.

sa: वृषादर्भिप्रयुक्तैषा निहता मे तपोधनाः। दुष्टा हिंस्यादियं पापा युष्मान् प्रत्यग्निसम्भवा)।१३७
en: You ascetics having penances for wealth, begged on by that king, she had come but I have killed her. That wicked and sinful creature, originated from the sacrificial fire, would otherwise have taken your lives.

sa: मत्स्यो यथान्यः स्यादप्सु सम्प्रयोगस्तथा तयोः। सम्बन्धस्तोयबिन्दूनां पण कोकनदस्य च॥
en: As a fish in water is different from it, so is the relation of the two (viz., Purusha and Nature). Indeed, their relation is like that of water drops on the leaf of the lotus,

sa: तैस्तैश्च नियमैः शूरा बहवः सन्ति चापरे। वेदाध्ययनशूराश्च शूराश्चाध्यापने रताः॥
en: There are various other kinds of heroes who practise various other kinds of vows and observances. There are heroes given to the study of the Vedas, and heroes devoted to the teaching of the same.

sa: एवं नो विस्मयकरं संशयं मधुसूदन। त्वमेवार्हसि कल्याण वक्तुं वह्नर्विनिर्गमम्॥
en: Even this, O destroyer of Madhu, is a matter of wonder and doubt with us. O source of all auspiciousness, you should explain to us that doubt, viz., the issue of fire from your mouth.

sa: ततः सस्यानि रोहन्ति येन वर्तयते जगत्। मांसमेदोऽस्थिशुक्राणां प्रादुर्भावस्ततः पुनः॥
en: Then do people sow various kinds of crops upon whose outturn the universe of creatures depends. It is from the food thus produced that the flesh, fat, bones and vital seed of all beings originate.

sa: नमस्कार्यास्तथा विप्रा वर्तमाना यथातथम्। यथासुखं यथोत्साह ललन्तु त्वयि पुत्रवत्॥
en: Let the Brahmanas live in whatever way they like. You should always bend your head to them with respect. Let them always rejoice in you as your children, living happily and according to their wishes.

sa: महाभूतानि नित्यानि भूताधिपतिसंश्रयात्। तेषां च नित्यसंवासो न विनाशो वियुज्यताम्॥
en: The great primal elements are eternal on account of the union with them of the Lord of all beings. They exist with what is eternal. Accordingly, they have no destruction when the non-eternal are destroyed.

sa: देवानामुपरिष्टाच्च गावः प्रतिवसन्ति वै। दत्त्वा चैतास्तारयन्ते यान्ति स्वर्ग मनीषिणः॥
en: Kine live in a region that is even greater than the region of the celestials. When given away, they save their givers. Wise men succeed in acquiring the celestial region by making gifts of kine.

sa: याच्यमाहुरनीशस्य अभिहारं च भारत। उद्वेजयन्ति याचन्ति सदा भूतानि दस्युवत्॥
en: The wise have said that an act of begging on the part of a poor man is a great reproach. Thosc persons who solicit others are said to annoy the world like thieves and robbers.

sa: त्वत्प्रभावार्जितान् भोगानश्नीम यदुनन्दन। पराक्रमेण बुद्ध्या च त्वयेयं निर्जिता पही।॥
en: O delighter of the Kurus, the various enjoyments we enjoy, have all been acquired are are through your power. The whole Earth has been subjugated by you with the help of your prowess and intelligence.

sa: सुरस्यमिदं प्रोक्तं देवानां भरतर्षभ। कच्चिन्नेदं श्रुतं पार्थ मनुष्येणेह कर्हिचित्॥
en: O chief of Bharata's race, this is a great mystery among the celestials that has been declared. At no time or place; O son of Pritha, has this teen heard by man in this world.

sa: वाक्तीक्ष्णो निकृतिप्रज्ञो द्वेष्टा विश्वस्य सर्वशः। मिथ्याकृतोऽपि विधिना परस्वहरणे रतः॥
en: I was harsh in speech. I considered cunning as wisdom. I hated all creatures. Taking advantage of pretexts in agreements made between myself and others I used always to take away what belonged to others.

sa: तेषामन्योन्यसम्मादूष्मेव समजायत। दिदृक्षूणां हयं तं च तं चैव हयसारिणम्॥
en: So great was the crowd of spectators that came to see the horse and the prince who was to follow it, that on account of the pressure of bodies, it seemed a fire was created.

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच अहिंसा परमो धर्म इत्युक्तं बहुशस्त्वया। जातो नः संशयो धर्मे मांसस्य परिवर्जने। दोषो भक्षयतः कः स्यात् कश्चाभक्षयतो गुणः॥
en: Yudhishthira said You have told it many times that abstention from injury is the highest Religion. In Shraddhas, however, that are performed in honour of the departed Manes, persons for their own behoof, should make offerings of various kinds of meat. A doubt has, therefore, sprung in our mind about the duty of abstaining from meat. What are the sins that one commits by eating meat, and what are the merits that one acquires?

sa: नमस्तेऽस्तु महाप्राज्ञ किं करोमि प्रशाधि माम्। त्वत्तपोबलनिर्दिष्टमिदं ह्यधिगतं मया॥
en: I bow my head to you, O you of great wisdom. Do you command me as to what I should now do. Ordained by the power of your penances, I have come by this position.

sa: नूनमश्रद्दधानोऽसि दुर्मेधा ह्यसि पाण्डव। न च शक्यं पुनर्वक्तुमशेषेण धनंजय॥
en: Forsooth, O son of Pandu, you are destitute of faith and your unde tanding is not good. It is impossible for me, U Dhananjaya, to repeat, in full, all that I said on that occasion.

sa: भवत्कृतमिमं स्नेहं युधिष्ठिरविवर्धितम्॥ न पृष्ठतः करिष्यन्ति पौरा जानपदा जनाः।
en: The affection which you have shown towards us and which in Yudhishthira is seen to exist in a still larger measurc, is incapable of being forgotten by the people of the city and the provinces.

sa: धनबुद्धिश्रुतैीन: केवलं तेजसान्वितः। महत् प्रार्थयसे नूनं तेनासि हरिणः कृशः॥
en: Indeed though destitute of riches and intelligence and Vedic learning you wish yet, with the help of your energy alonc, to accomplish something great. It is for this that you are so pale and lean.

sa: पूर्णे वर्षसहस्रान्ते क्षीणे कर्मणि दुष्कृते। प्राप्स्यसे शाश्वतान्लोकाञ्जितान् स्वेनैव कर्मणा।।२६
en: Upon the completion of a full thousand years, when your sin will be dissipated you shall then attain to many regions of unending happiness that have been acquired by you through your own pious deeds.

sa: द्विपदानि द्वयान्याहुः पार्थिवानीतराणि च। पार्थिवानि विशिष्टानि तानि ह्यन्नानि भुञ्जते॥
en: Bipeds, again, are of two sorts, viz., those that live on land and those that are otherwise. Of these, the former are superior to the latter. The superior ones eat various sorts of cooked food.

sa: भ्रूणहाऽऽहवमध्ये तु शुद्ध्यते शस्त्रपाततः॥ आत्मानं जुहुयादग्नौ समिद्धे तेन शुद्ध्यते।
en: One guilty of foeticide becomes purified if he dies of wounds received in battle fought for the sake of kine and Brahmanas. He may also be purified by casting his person on a burning fire.

sa: तत्र वेदविदः प्राज्ञा गाम्भीर्ये सागरोपमाः७४।। कृप्यादिष्वभवन् सक्ता मूर्खाः श्राद्धान्यभुञ्जत।
en: Amongst them, even wise persons wellread in the Vedas, and resembling the ocean itself in gravity, have begun to follow agriculture and similar callings Illiterate and ignorant persons have begun to be fed at Shraddhas.

sa: तमैरावतमूर्धस्थं प्रेक्ष्य देवगणैर्वृतम्। सुरेन्द्रमिन्द्रं दैत्येन्द्रो न शुशोच न विव्यथे॥
en: Seeing the king of gods, viz., Indra, thus seated on the back of Airavata and surrounded by the several orders of the celestials, the king of the Daityas displayed no signs of sorrow or agitation.

sa: स तस्मै सक्रियां चक्रे क्रियायुक्तेन हेतुना। विश्रान्तं सुसमासीनमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: The house-holder duly respected his guest according to those ordinances of worship that are laid down in the scriptures. Seeing his guest refreshed and seated at ease, the host addressed him in the following words.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्तस्तुलाधारो ब्राह्मणेन यशस्विना। उवाच धर्मसूक्ष्माणि वैश्यो धर्मार्थतत्त्ववित्॥
en: Thus accosted by that highly famous Brahmana, Tuladhara of the Vaishya caste, well acquatinted with the truths of morality and contented with knowledge, described to Jajali who had practised severe penances, the ways of morality.

sa: यदि सत्यपि लिङ्गेऽस्मिन् ज्ञानमेवात्र कारणम्। निर्मोक्षायेह दुःखस्य लिङ्गमानं निरर्थकम्॥
en: When, despite the adoption of these emblems of a particular mode of life, Knowledge along becomes the cause of one's Liberation from sorrow, it would appear that the adoption of mere emblems is absolutely useless.

sa: स्रवन्ति हुंदराद् गर्भा जायमानास्तथा परे। आगमेन तथान्येषां विनाश उपपद्यते॥
en: Some embryos fall from the womb. Some come out alive. While as regards some, they are destroyed in the womb, after being quickened with life, on account of some other bodies being ready for them.

sa: तपसा चानुमानेन गुणैर्जात्या श्रुतेन च। निनीषेत् परमं ब्रह्म विशुद्धनान्तरात्मना॥
en: With purified soul, one should try to approach the Supreme Brahma, through the help afforded by penances, by inferences, by self-control, by the practices and observances sanctioned for one's own order, and by the Vedas.

sa: इष्टीश्च विविधाः प्राप्य ऋतूंश्चैवाप्तदक्षिणान्। प्राप्नोति नैव ब्राह्मण्यमविधानात् कथंचन॥ कल्पते॥
en: Having performed only various sorts or religious rights and various sacrifices completed with sacrificial presents, one does not gain the dignity of a Brahmana if he is devoid of mercy and has not renounced desire.

sa: मात्मानमन्विच्छति चाप्रमत्तः। न लिप्यते कर्मफलैरनिष्टः पत्रं विसस्येव जलेन सिक्तम्॥
en: One who is conversant with that understanding which brings on Liberation and who carefully seeks to know the soul, is never sullied by the evil fruits of his acts water is never soaked by it.

sa: नाधर्मः श्लिष्यते प्राज्ञं पयः पुष्करपर्णवत्। अप्राज्ञमधिकं पापं श्लिष्यते जतुकाष्ठवत्॥
en: Sin cannot attach to a wise man as water cannot drench the leaves of the lotus. Sin sticks more firmly to him who is without attachment as lac and wood stick firmly to each other.

sa: वियोगधर्मिणा चैव विमुक्तात्मा भवत्यथा विमोक्षिणा विमोक्षश्च समेत्येह तथा भवेत्॥
en: By uniting with one who is shorn of all attachments, he becomes freed from all attachments. By uniting with one striving after Liberation, he himself partaking of the nature of his companion, strives after Liberation.

sa: प्रजा ब्राह्मणपसंस्काराः स्वकर्मकृतनिश्चयाः। ऋषिभिः स्वेन तपसा सृज्यन्ते चापरे परैः॥
en: The great Rishis who at the beginning were created (by Brahman's Will) afterwards themselves created, through their penances, men devoted to the duties laid down for them and rites laid down in the Eternal Vedas.

sa: तस्मै नमध्वं देवाय निर्गुणाय महात्मने। अजाय विश्वरूपाय धाम्ने सर्वदिवौकसाम्॥
en: Do you all bow to that Illustrious One who is gifted with a high soul and who is above the : three qualities, who is Unborn, abode or refuge of all the dwellers of heaven.

sa: अधिष्ठानानि बुद्ध्या हि पृथगेतानि पञ्चधा। इन्द्रियाणीति तान्याहुस्तेषु दुष्टेषु दुष्यति॥
en: The five senses with the Mind, which separately form the foundations (of the Understanding), are the creations of the Understanding. They are called Indriyas or organs. When they become stained, the Understanding also becomes sullied.

sa: तस्माद् योगं समास्थाय त्यक्त्वा गृहकलेवरम्। वायुभूतः प्रवेक्ष्यामि तेजोराशिं दिवाकरम्॥
en: I shall, therefore, have recourse to Yoga, and renouncing this body which is my present residence, I shall change myself into a wind and enter that mass of effulgence which is represented by the sin.

sa: संगुप्तान्यात्मनो द्वाराण्यपिधाय विचिन्तयन्। यो ह्यास्ते ब्राह्मणः शिष्टः स आत्मरतिरुच्यते॥
en: Suspending his senses that have been properly checked from unworthy indulgence, he who lives in Yoga meditation, is said to be a Brahma. Such a person is said to acquire his joys from the Soul.

sa: स तत्र न्यवसद् विप्रो घृणी किञ्चिदसंस्पृशन्। क्षुधितश्छन्द्यमानोऽपि भोजनं नाभ्यनन्दत॥
en: Thus accosted, the newly-arrived Brahmana, full of mercy as he was, passed the night there, without touching anything. Though hungry and requested again and again, the guest refused to touch any food in that house.

sa: त्रीणि वर्षाण्युपास्याग्निं भ्रूणहा विप्रमुच्यते।।२७ महासरः पुष्कराणि प्रभासोत्तरमानसे। अभ्येत्य योजनशतं भ्रूणहा विप्रमुच्यते॥ यावतः प्राणिनो हन्यात् तज्जातीयांस्तु तावतः प्रमीयमानानुन्मोच्य प्राणिहा विप्रमुच्यते॥
en: One guilty of foeticide is purified by adoring the fire for three years. One guilty for foeticide becomes purifies at even a hundred Yojanas from Mahasara, or the Tirthas called Pushkara, or Prabhasa, or Manasa on the north, if only he sets out for any of them. A slayer of creatures is purged of his sins by saving from impending danger as many creatures of that particular kind as have been killed by him.

sa: अत्र ते वर्तयिष्यामि जन्मयोगफलं तथा। शुकस्याश्यां गतिं चैव दुर्विदामकृतात्मभिः॥
en: I shall, now, recite to you the circumstances of Shuka's birth, the fruits he acquired of his penances, and the foremost end he achieved. These are the topics which persons of uncleansed souls cannot understand.

sa: दमो नान्यस्पृहा नित्यं गाम्भीर्यं धैर्यमेव च। अभयं रोगशमनं ज्ञानेनैतदवाप्यते॥
en: Self-control consists in never wishing for another man's property, in gravity and patience and power to remove the fears of others regarding one's own self, and freedom from disease. It may be won through knowledge.

sa: याज्ञवल्क्य उवाच अव्यक्तस्य नरश्रेष्ठ कालसंख्यां निबोध मे। पञ्चकल्पसहस्राणि द्विगुणान्यहरुच्यते॥
en: Yajnavalkya said Listen to me, O foremost of men, as I tell you what the duration of time is about the Supreme Purusha. Ten thousand Kalpas are said to form a single day of his.

sa: यदेकपातिनां सतां भवत्यमुत्र गच्छताम्। भयेषु साम्परायिकं निधत्स्व केवलं निधिम्॥
en: When men have to go alone and without companions to the region of Yama, it is clear that in view of such a situation of terror, you should try to acquire that one only treasure.

sa: नाभुक्तवति चाश्नीयादपीतवति नो पिबेत्। नातिष्ठति तथाऽऽसीत नासुप्ते प्रस्वपेत च॥
en: He should never eat before his preceptor has eaten; never drink before his preceptor has drunk; never sit down before is preceptor has sat down; and never go to bed before his preceptor has gone.

sa: इह धर्मपराः केचित् केचिन्नैकृतिका नराः। सुखिता दुःखितः केचिन्निर्धना धनिनोऽपरे॥
en: There some, with great exertion, try to suppress the vital airs. Here some men and devoted to righteousness, and some addicted to deceit. Some are happy and some wretched; some are poor and some, rich.

sa: हित्वा तु सुचिरं भक्ष्यं भोज्यांश्च तप आस्थितः। इत्येतदभिभूतानामद्भुतं जनमेजय॥
en: Forsaking luxurious food and all articles of enjoyment, you are now practising rigid penances for a long time. All this, O Janamejaya, is sure to appear wonderful to those kings who are sunk in sin.

sa: जन्तोः पञ्चेन्द्रियस्यास्य यदेकं छिद्रमिन्द्रियम्। ततोऽस्य स्रवते प्रज्ञा दृतेः पादादिवोदकम्।१५।।
en: If even one of the five senses of a human being be kept ungoverned all his wisdom escapes through it like water through a hole not made up at the bottom of a leather bag.

sa: पितेव पुत्रान् रक्षेथा ब्राह्मणान् धर्मचेतसः। गृहे चैषामवेक्षेथाः किंस्विदस्तीति जीवनम्॥
en: The Kshatriya should protect all pious Brahmanas as a father protects his sons. He should always look after the houses of the Brahmanas for finding out that the means of subsistence may not be wanting.

sa: अपवर्गेऽथ संत्यागे बुद्धौ च कृतनिश्चयाः। ब्रह्मिष्ठा ब्रह्मभूताश्च ब्रह्मण्येव कृतालयाः॥
en: They have, in their own understandings, formed fixed conclusions regarding all destructible objects and a life of at are Renunciation. Devoted to Brahma, and already at one with Brahma, they have taken refuge in Brahma.

sa: अनुकूला: कथाः कृत्वा यथागतमपृच्छता ऋषिः परमतेजस्वी धर्मात्मा संशितव्रतः॥
en: Possessed of great energy, and a righteous soul, that Rishi of rigid vows conversed with his host on many agreeable subjects and informed him of the place whence he had come.

sa: ऐश्वर्यमदमत्तांश्च मत्तान् मद्यमदेन च। अप्रमत्ताः शठाञ्छूरा विक्रान्ताः पर्युपासते॥
en: Even men who are perfectly careful, who are honest, and brave and endued with prowess, are seen to worship men intoxicated with the pride of wealth and with even alcoholic stimulants.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि मनश्चैव विज्ञानान्यस्य भारत। सप्तमी बुद्धिरित्याहुः क्षेत्रज्ञः पुनरष्टमः॥
en: The senses and the mind, O Bharata are the organs through which the cognition of a living creature is made. The seventh is the understanding; and the eight is the soul.

sa: दिव्यं वर्षसहस्रं ते तपस्तप्त्वा सुदारुणम्। शुश्रुवुर्मधुरां वाणी वेदवेदाङ्गभूषिताम्॥
en: For a thousand divine years they were engaged in those severe penances. At the conclusion of that time they heard these sweet words in harmony with the Vedas and their branches.

sa: ततः परासून् खादन्तं शृगालं वानरोऽब्रवीत्। श्मशानमध्ये सम्प्रेक्ष्य पूर्वजातिमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Seeing the jackal one day eating an animal car-case in the midst of a crematorium, the ape, remembering his own and his friend's pristine birth as human beings, addressed him, saying,

sa: परावरदृशः शक्तिर्ज्ञानमूला न नश्यति। पश्यतः सर्वभूतानि सर्वावस्थासु सर्वदा॥
en: Having its roots in knowledge, the power is never lost of the man who (thus) sees the Supreme in his soul,-of the man, who always sees all creatures in all conditions.

sa: नियताहारता नित्यं व्रतचर्या यथाक्रमम्। धर्मो हि धर्मसम्बन्धादिन्द्रियाणां विशेषतः॥
en: Frugality of fare and observance of vows in due order, form merit (for persons of all classes) on account of the connection that exists between the senses and the duties religion.

sa: सम्मानश्चावमानश्च लाभालाभौ क्षयोदयौ। प्रवृत्ता विनिवर्तन्ते विधानान्ते पदे पदे॥
en: Honour and dishonour, profit and loss, destruction and growth, are seen to set in. No one can resist them. None of them is everlasting for it must disappear in the end.

sa: समाहितं परे तत्त्वे क्षीणकाममवस्थितम्। सर्वतः सुखमन्वेति वपुश्चान्द्रमसं यथा॥
en: Regarding one who lives after having destroyed desire and devoting himself to the highest subject of existence, it should be said that his happiness is continuously increased like the lunar disc.

sa: अव्यक्ताद् व्यक्तमुत्पन्नं लोकसृष्ट्यर्थमीश्वरात्। अनिरुद्धो हि लोकेषु महानात्मेति कथ्यते॥
en: From the powerful Unmanifest sprang, for the creation of all the worlds, he that is called Aniruddha. That Aniruddha is known among all creatures by the name of the Great Soul.

sa: चारित्रमात्मनः पश्यंश्चन्द्रशुद्धमनामयम्। धर्मात्मा लभते कीर्तिं प्रेत्य चेह यथासुखम्॥
en: The virtuous man by seeing his own conduct has become bright as the moon and free from every sort of evil, succeeds in happily acquiring great fame both here and hereafter.

sa: तं त्वां देवासुरनरास्तत्त्वेन न विदुर्भवम्। मोहिताः खल्वनेनैव हृदिस्थेनाप्रकाशिना॥
en: Although you live in the heart, yet are you concealed. Hence, stupefied by you the deities and Asuras and men cannot understand you, O Bhava, truly and in all your details.

sa: कललाद् बुद्बुदोत्पत्तिः पेशी च बुबुदात् स्मृता। पेश्यास्त्वङ्गाभिनिर्वृत्तिर्नखरोमाणि चाङ्गतः॥
en: From 'Kalala' originates bubble. From 'Budbuda' originates what is called 'Peshi.' From 'Peshi' that stage originates in which the various limbs are seen. From this last stage appear nails and hair.

sa: ततः सहस्रं विप्राणां विदुषां समलंकृतम्। स्नातानामनुसम्प्राप्तं सुमहत् क्षौमवाससाम्॥
en: Just about this time a thousand Brahmanas, endued with great learning, with bodies purified by baths and adorned with sandalpaste and flowers, and clad in long robes of linen, came there.

sa: चान्द्रायणानि विधिवल्लिङ्गानि विविधानि च। चातुराश्रम्यपन्थानमाश्रयत्यपथानपि॥ उपाश्रमानण्यपरान् पाषण्डान् विविधानपि। विविक्ताच शिलाच्छायास्तथा प्रस्रवणानि च॥ पुलिनानि विविक्तानि विविक्तानि वनानि च। देवस्थानानि पुण्यानि विविक्तानि सरांसि च॥ विविक्ताश्चापि शैलानां गुहा गृहनिभोपमाः। विविक्तानि च जप्यानि व्रतानि विविधानि च॥ नियमान् विविधांश्चापि विविधानि तपांसि च। यज्ञांश्च विविधाकारान् विधींश्च विविधांस्तथा॥
en: The Soul considers himself as following the observance of Chandrayana according to the rites laid down in the scriptures, or various other vows and observances, and the courses of duty laid down for the four modes of life, and even prohibitions of duty, and the duties of other subsidiary modes of life set down the four principal ones, and even various kinds of practices that distinguish the wicked and sinful. The Soul considers himself as enjoying lonely places and the charming shades of mountains and the cool vicinity of springs and fountains, and solitary river banks and secluded forests, and sacred pilgrimages, and lakes and waters remote from the busy haunts of men, and linely mountain caves giving the accommodation that houses and palaces afford. The Soul consider himself as reciting

sa: भक्तानामनुकम्पार्थं दर्शनं च यथाश्रुतम्॥ मुनीनां ब्रुवतां दिव्यमीशानचरितं शुभम्।
en: While ascetics discoursed on the auspicious and excellent deeds of Ishana, I have heard from then how, moved by mercy towards his worshippers, he grants them a sight of his body.

sa: इदं कृतमिदं कार्यमिदमन्यत् कृताकृतम्। एवमीहासुखासक्तं कृतान्तः कुरुते वशे॥
en: Death attacks a man while he enjoys the happiness arising from the gratification of desire, and while he still thinks,-this has been done; this is be done; this has been half-done.

sa: प्रजामाचक्षते विप्राः पुराणाः शाशबिन्दवीम्। स वृष्णिवंशप्रभवो महावंशः प्रजापतेः॥
en: The ancient Brahmanas bestowed a name on the creatures of the world, derived from Shashavindu. That extensive family of the Patriarch Shashavindu became in time the progenitor of the Vrishni race.

sa: कासि कस्य कुतश्चेति त्वयाहमभिचोदिता। तत्रोत्तरमिदं वाक्यं राजन्नेकमनाः शृणु॥
en: You have asked me who I am, whose I am, whence I am coming, etc. Listen now to me, O king, with full mind, as I answer these questions of yours.

sa: अथौघवान् नाम नृपो नृगस्यासीत् पितामहः। तस्याथौघवती कन्या पुत्रश्चौवरथोऽभवत्॥
en: There was also a king named Oghavat, who was the grandfather of Nriga. He had a daughter named Oghavati, and a son, too, of the name of Ogharatha born to him.

sa: सापयित्वा तु धरणी स्वे स्थाने पुरुषोत्तमः। जलकर्दमलिप्ताङ्गो लोककार्यार्थमुद्यतः॥
en: Having replaced the Earth in her former position, that foremost of Purushas, his body smeared with water and mud, began to do what was necessary for the world and its inhabitants.

sa: एवं शक्रेण कौरव्य बुद्धिसौक्ष्म्यान्महासुरः। उपायपूर्वं निहतो वृत्रो ह्यमिततेजसा॥
en: It was thus, O Kuru chief, that the powerful Asura Vritra was killed by Shakra of great energy by the help of subtle intelligence and through the application of means. son

sa: भगवत्युत्तमैश्वर्यं ब्रह्मविष्णुपुरोगमम्। विद्यते वै महादेवाद् ब्रूहि कः परमेश्वरात्॥
en: That great power, which is in that illustrious Being who created Brahman, Vishnu, and Rudra, was derived from Mahadeva. Tell me who is there who is superior to the Supreme Lord?

sa: तस्मात् कौन्तेय विदुषा धर्माधर्मविनिश्चये। बुद्धिमास्थाय लोकेऽस्मिन् वर्तितव्यं कृतात्मना॥
en: Therefore, O son of Kunti, a person of purified soul and endued with learning should live and act in this world, depending upon his own intelligence in ascertaining virtue and vice.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्। गीतं विदेहराजेन जनकेन प्रशाम्यता॥
en: "Regarding it is also cited the old story of the verses sung by Janaka, the king of the Videhas, who had so qualified himself as to obtain tranquillity of the soul.

sa: अर्चिष्मन्तो बर्हिषदः कव्यादाः पितरस्तथा। मृतस्याप्यनुमन्यन्ते मन्त्रान् मन्त्राश्च कारणम्॥
en: Then again the three classes of Pitris, viz., the Archishmats, the Varihshads, and the Kravyads, approve of the necessity of Mantras about the dead, and Mantras are regarded as powerful causes.

sa: एवं विजानल्लोकेऽस्मिन् कः कस्येत्यभिनिश्चितः। मोक्षे निवेशय मनो भूयश्चाप्युपधारय॥
en: When such is the case, who is the world is to be considered as whose? Do you, therefore, think of acquiring Liberation. Hear now what more I shall say to you.

sa: न चास्ति शक्तिस्त्रैलोक्ये कस्यचित् पुरुषोत्तम। पतिव्रतामिमां साध्वीं तवोद्वीक्षितुमप्युत॥
en: O best of men, no one in the three worlds has the power to insult, even with looks, this chaste lady devoted to her husband, far less to touch her body.

sa: निर्ममो निरहंकारो निराशीर्मुक्तबन्धनः। स्वस्थो व्यपेतः पश्यामि भूतानां प्रभवाप्ययौ॥
en: Without attachments, without pride, without desire and hope, freed from all fetters, and dissociated from everything, I am passing my time happily, seeing that appearance and disappearance of all created objects.

sa: उत्पादितं वृषाङ्केन दीप्तज्वलनसंनिभम्। दत्तं भगवता तुभ्यं दुर्धर्षं तेजसाद्भुतम्॥
en: That discus, effulgent as fire, was created by the great god having the bull for his emblem. Wonderful and irresistible in energy, it was given to you by that illustrious god.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा विनिश्चित्य रौद्रकर्मा स लुब्धकः। महाप्रस्थानमाश्रित्य प्रययौ संशितव्रतः॥
en: Having thus made up his mind and said these words, that fowler, once of dreadful deeds, started on a journey never to end, observing all the while the most rigid vows.

sa: पाविताङ्गाः स्म संवृत्ताः श्रुत्वेमामादितः कथाम्। नारायणाश्रयां पुण्यां सर्वपापप्रमोचनीम्॥
en: Having listened to this discourse of yours that has Narayana for its theme, that is sacred and capable of purifying one of every sin, all of us have certainly become holy.

sa: नश्यन्त्यर्थास्तथा भोगा: स्थानमैश्वर्यमेव च॥ जीवितं जीवलोकस्य कालेनागम्य नीयते।
en: Wealth, comforts, rank, prosperity, all are destroyed by Time. Approaching every living creature. Time takes away his life. All things which haughtily raise their heads high are sure to crumble down.

sa: किमेतदिति तत्त्वेन प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ। देहान्तरमनासाद्य कथं स ब्राह्मणोऽभवत्॥
en: Therefore, O foremost one of Bharata's race do you relate this matter to me truly! How without renouncing his body and taking another body of flesh could he become a Brahmana?

sa: तद् वनं वृक्षसम्पूर्ण लताविटपसंकुलम्॥ ददाह पावकः क्रुद्धो युगान्ताग्निसमप्रभः।
en: The raging element, appearing like the fire at the end of the Cycle, the powerful fire began to consume that large forest abounding with tall trees and thick bushes and creepers.

sa: प्रेयं घ्राणं शरीरं च भूमेरेते गुणास्त्रयः। एतावानिन्द्रियग्रामैर्व्याख्यातः पाञ्चभौतिकः॥
en: Scent, nose, and the body,-these three,-form the attributes of earth. These then, as I have explained to you, are the changes of the five (great) elements in connection with the senses.

sa: किमेतदिति तत्त्वेन प्रब्रूहि भरतर्षभ। देहान्तरमनासाद्य कथं स ब्राह्मणोऽभवत्॥
en: Therefore, O foremost one of Bharata's race do you relate this matter to me truly! How without renouncing his body and taking another body of flesh could he become a Brahmana?

sa: ब्राह्मणा गुरवश्चेमे तथा मान्या गुरूत्तमाः। त्वं चाथ गुरुरप्येषामेवमन्योन्यगौरवम्॥
en: All these Brahmanas deserve respect. They are foremost of preceptors. You also are worthy of their respect, being their king. Doing them respect, you are entitled to receive reverence from them.

sa: इदमन्तरमित्येव शक्रो नृपममोहयत्। एकाश्वेन च राजर्षिर्धान्त इन्द्रेण मोहितः॥
en: Saying to himself, this, indeed, is an opportunity, Indra stupefied th, king. The king went alone on his horse, confounded, because of the king of the gods having stupefied his senses.

sa: नक्षत्रकल्पाभरणां तां मौक्तिकसमस्रजम्। श्रियं ददृशतुः पद्मां साक्षात् पद्मदलस्थिताम्॥
en: Decorated with ornaments that appeared like veritable stars, she wore a wreath resembling a garland of pearls. Indra saw that goddess called Padma living in the midst of lotuses. light up

sa: महच्च फलवैषम्यं दृश्यते कर्मसंधिषु। वहन्ति शिबिकामन्ये यान्त्यन्ये शिबिकागताः॥
en: A great disparity is seen about the fruits that wait upon conjunctions of acts. Some are seen to carry vehicles on their shoulders, while some are seen to ride on them.

sa: उरसा धारयन् निष्कमग्निमालां यथाचलः। तस्य हेममयं चित्रं बहुरूपाङ्गशोभितम्॥
en: His arms were duly adorned and that one of potent illusive energy wore Angadas and a cuirass on his breast like a circle of fire on the breast of a mountain.

sa: रसवत् पाययामासुः पानं मदसमीरणम्। पीतोपवृत्तान् स्नातांश्च जग्धान्नान् समलंकृतान्॥
en: Having caused those four steeds to slake their thirsts and walk and bathe and eat and having decked them with garlands of gold, men plucked the arrows out of their bodies;

sa: उत्तनयनै रोषात् संदष्टौष्ठपुटैर्मुखैः। सकुण्डलैर्मही च्छन्ना पद्मकिञ्जल्कसंनिभैः॥ भुजैश्छिन्नैर्महाराज नागराजकरोपमैः। साङ्गदैः सतनुत्रैश्च सासिप्रासपरश्वधैः॥ कबन्धैरुत्थितैश्छिन्नैर्नृत्यद्भिश्चापरैर्युधि। क्रव्यादगणसंछन्ना घोराभूत् पृथिवी विभो॥
en: Covered also, O king, with the arms of warriors resembling the trunks of huge elephants, that were bedecked with Angada and coated in leathern fences and that still held swords and lances and battle-axes and with headless bodies standing on their feet and bleeding and dancing on the field and abounding with various carnivorous animals, the earth, O king, appeared exceedingly terrific.

sa: अक्षतान् कुरुपाञ्चालान् पश्येयमिति कामये। सर्वे सुमनसस्तात शाम्याम भरतर्षभ॥
en: I desire that I shall see the Kauravas and the Panchalas, without any wounds and we shall all establish peace with cheerful hearts, O you best among the race of Bharata.

sa: गृहीतशस्त्राः क्रोशन्ति चर्मिणो वाजिपृष्ठगाः। अरुणोदये प्रदृश्यन्ते शतशः शलभव्रजाः॥
en: Here and there everywhere horse men clad in armours and armed with weapons give out war cries. In the morning when the sun rises, hundreds of fights of insects are seen

sa: असुशं शौचमित्याहुरर्थानामुपधारणे। आनाम्य फलितां शाखां पक्वं पक्वं प्रशातयेत्॥
en: It is said that in earning wealth, hypocrisy is a cheap means. As a hooked staff is used to bend down a bough of a tree of pluck the ripe fruits.

sa: ते किरन्तः शरवातान् बारणप्रतिवारणान्। रणे जयमभीप्सन्तः कौन्तेयं पर्यवारयन्॥
en: Pouring showers of arrows of such fierce energy as were capable of obstructing the course of hostile elephants, those heroes surrounded the son of Kunti, desirous of defeating him in battle.

sa: महाकाया महावीर्याः कालखजा इवासुराः। वीर्योन्मत्ता बलोदग्रा राज्ञा समभिपूजिताः॥
en: They were of colossal forms and of exceeding might, like the demons named Kalakhanjas; they were maddened with their latent power; furious with their prowess and highly honored by the king.

sa: तमभ्यधावनिहते कुमारे कैकेयसेनापतिरुप्रकर्मा। शरैर्विधुिन्वन् भृशमुग्रवेगैः कर्णात्मजं चाप्यहनत् प्रसेनम्॥
en: Then the Kaikeya General Ugrakarman, seeing the Kaikeyas prince thus killed rushed on towards Karna and moving forward his bow repeatedly began to distress Karna's son Prasena with many powerful shafts.

sa: वेदी चाप्यददद्वैमी कश्यपाय महात्मने। दशव्यामायतां कृत्वा नवोत्सेधां विशाम्पते॥
en: O king, he built an altar made of gold which was ten vyamas (2O yards) in breadth and nine in height. He made a gift of it to the illustrious Kashyapa.

sa: ततः शरं महाराज सर्वकायावदारणम्। प्राहिणोद् भीमसेनाय बलायेन्द्र इवाशनिम्॥
en: Therefore, O mighty monarch with a view to bring about the slaughter of Bhima, Karna sped at him an arrow capable of penetrating through all bodies, like Indra hurling the thunder.

sa: दन्तान् संदशतस्तस्य कोपाद् ददृशुराननम्। युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि कालस्येव जिघत्सतः॥
en: When he began to grind his teeth in anger, the kings saw his face resemble like that of the Death preparing to swallow every creature at the end of the Yuga.

sa: भार्यावन्त: क्रियावन्तः सभार्या गृहमेधिनः। भार्यावन्तः प्रमोदन्ते भार्यावन्तः श्रियान्विताः॥
en: Those that have wives can perform religious acts; those that have wives lead domestic lives. Those that have wives can be happy and those that have wives can achieve good fortune.

sa: द्रौपद्युवाच अप्रार्थनीयामिह मां सूतपुत्राभिमन्यसे। निहीनवर्णां सैरन्ध्रीं बीभत्सां केशकारिणीम्॥
en: Draupadi said I am Sairandhri of low caste holding the hateful office of dressing hair; O Suta's son, in desiring me you desire one who is not worthy of such honour.

sa: लोकसम्भावितैर्दुःखं यत् प्राप्तं कुरुसत्तम। प्राप्य जाति मनुष्येषु देवैरपि पितामह॥ कदा वयं करिष्यामः संन्यासं दुःखसंज्ञकम्। दुःखमेतच्छरीराणां धारणं कुरुसत्तम॥
en: Though respected of all the world, O best of the Kurus, and though we have been born among men, O grandfather, having been begotten by the very gods, yet when so much sorrow has come to us, it appears, O reverened chief, that birth in an embodied form is the root of all sorrow! Alas, when shall we adopt a life of Renunciation which dissipates sorrow?

sa: ब्रुवाणोऽपि हितं वाक्यमिष्टो भ्राता विभीषणः। दृष्टं परुषितो मोहात्त्वयात्मवधकाङ्गिणा॥
en: Although your brother Vibhīşana addressed you with words pregnant with your welfare-you, for your own destruction, out of your misgivings, did excite his anger and have (now) seen (the result thereof).

sa: पौरवाणां महाराज तेषामक्लिष्टकर्मणाम्। वंशे जातस्य कौरव्य नानुरूपमिदं तव॥
en: O great king, being born in the Puru dynasty, ever famous for its pure acts and being a descendant of the Kuru race, you should not have committed such an act.

sa: द्रोणानीकमसम्बाधं मम प्रियचिकीर्षया। भित्त्वा व्यूहं प्रविष्टोऽसौ गोमध्यमिव केसरी॥
en: Desirous of doing an act agreeable to me, he (Abhimanyu) penetrated the array of Drona with the least difficulty, like a lion penetrating into the midst of a herd of kine.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा धर्मराजानमभ्यभाषत कौरवः॥ भद्रं ते यादवीमातर्वचश्चेदं निबोध मे।
en: Having said these words, the old king then addressed Yudhishthira in particular and said, 'Blessed by you, O son of the princess of Yudu's race! Listen now to what I say.

sa: असभ्या: सभ्यसंकाशा: सभ्याश्चासभ्यदर्शनाः। दृश्यन्ते विविधा भावास्तेषु युक्तं परीक्षणम्॥
en: Wicked persons sometimes pass for the virtues, and the virtues are sometimes taken for the wicked. There are various aspects in creatures. It is, therefore, necessary to examine which is which.

sa: धनुश्चास्यापरैश्छित्त्वा शरैः पार्थो विचक्रमे। अम्बष्ठस्तु गदां गृह्य कोपपर्याकुलेक्षणः॥
en: was Then with other arrows cutting off his bow, Arjuna began to career over the field. Thereat the ruler of the Ambashthas, with eyes rolling in rage, took up his mace.

sa: चिरमसम्युषितः पुत्र चिरं शुश्रूषितस्त्वया। वृद्धं मामप्यनुज्ञातुमर्हसि त्वं नराधिप॥
en: I have lived long under your protection, O son. I have for many years been served by you with respect. I am now old. You should, O king, grant me permission.

sa: राजोवाच संत्रस्तरूपस्त्राणार्थी त्वत्तो भीतो महाद्विज। मत्सकाशमनुप्राप्तः प्राणगृनुरयं द्विजः॥
en: The King said: O great bird, this one is afflicted with the fear of you; and desirous of escaping from you it has come in a fury to me for protection.

sa: सर्वायुधसमोपेतं सर्वशस्त्रविशारदम्। रथनागाश्वकलिलं पदातिध्वजसंकुलम्॥ तुष्टपुष्टबलोपेतं वीरलक्षणलक्षितम्। विचित्रध्वजसन्नाहं विचित्ररथकार्मुकम्॥ संनिवेश्य च कौरव्य द्वारकायां नरर्षभ। अभिसारयामास तदा वेगेन पतगेन्द्रवत्॥
en: O descendant of Kuru, O best of men, like the king of birds (Garuda), he rushed upon Dvarka, with his army, equipped with every kind of weapons, skilled in all arms, furnished with numerous chariots, elephants and cavalry, full of pennons and banners and strengthened with well-paid, well-fed and greatly powerful foot soldiers who bore every mark of heroism and who used wonderful chariots and bows.

sa: भ्रातरः पञ्च कैकेया धार्मिका: सत्यविक्रमाः। इन्द्रगोपकसंकाशा रक्तवर्मायुधध्वजाः॥ मातृष्वसुः सुता पाण्डवानां जयार्थिनः। तान् द्रोणं हन्तुमायातान् के वीराः पर्यवारयन्॥
en: The five Kekaya brothers, virtuous and endued with prowess incapable of being thwarted. Resembling the Indragopakas (in complexion), furnished with red armours and weapons and banners, those heroes who are the sons of the sister of the Pandavas' mother and who ever long for the victory of the Pandavas. What heroes of my army surrounded them when they assaulted Drona with a view to kill hin?

sa: कृते चतुष्पात् सकलो निर्व्याजोपाधिवर्जितः। वृषः प्रतिष्ठितोधर्मो मनुष्ये भरतर्षभ॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, in the Krita age, everything was free from deceit and guile, avarice and covetousness. Virtue like a bull was among men with four legs complete.

sa: अपेयः सागरो येषामपि शापान्महात्मनाम्। येषां कोपाग्निरद्यापि दण्डके नोपशाम्यति॥
en: Through the curse of those great ones, the ocean become so saline as to be undrinkable. The fire of their anger yet burns in the forest of Dandaka, unquenched by time.

sa: ते जघ्नुस्तौ महेष्वासौ ताभ्यां मुक्तांश्च सायकान्। विचेरुराकाशगताः पार्थबाणविदारिताः॥
en: Those arrows then struck those two fierce bowmen Shrutayusha and Achyutayush; and the arrows shot by these latter, being cut-off by those of Partha, began to drop down through the sky.

sa: राजोपक्रोशदोषाश्च सर्वे संश्रयवासिनाम्। व्रतचर्या तु नि:संगा निर्भया वनवासिनाम्॥
en: All who live in court have to suffer great pain for evil speeches against themselves. Those, however, who live in the forest, spend their days, fearlessly and without anxiety, observing vows.

sa: संग्रामशिरसो मध्ये भीमं द्वावप्यधावताम्। यथाम्बुपतिमित्रौ हि तारकं दैत्यसत्तमम्॥
en: Both rushed against Bhima in the van of the battle, as the lord of the water (i.e. Varuna) (had rushed against) Taraka, the foremost of the Daitayas (in days of yore).

sa: तथैव वृष्णिवीरेऽपि सात्वते युद्धदुर्मदे। अतिभारे नियुक्तश्च मया शैनेयनन्दनः॥
en: Is in no way greater than that I bear for that invincible hero of the Satvata race. That delighter of Sini's race, has been entrusted with a commission on my behalf.

sa: ततो भारत कुद्धेन तव पुत्रेण धन्विना। पाण्डुपुत्रस्त्रिभिर्बाणैर्वक्षस्यभिहतो बली॥
en: Thereupon, O descendant of the Bharata race, the most powerful son of Pandu was decply struck in the chest with three shafts by the bowman, your son, who was highly enraged.

sa: तस्य कर्णो धनुश्छित्त्वास्वर्णपुङ्खः शिलाशितैः। त्रिंशता परमेष्वासः शरैः पाण्डवमर्दयत्॥
en: Then Karna, that most powerful bowman, after having severed his (enemy's) bow with numerous shafts, winged with gold and sharpened on stone, crushed the son of Pandu with thirty other arrows.

sa: अहो वीर्यस्य सारत्वमहो सौष्ठवमेतयोः। स्थितावेतौ हि समरे कालान्तकयमोपमौ॥
en: O! what an essence of the energy of both. O! how great is their skill. Both persons are, indeed, waiting in the like two all-destroying Yamas at the end of time.

sa: रथशिक्षां तु दाशार्हो दर्शयामास वीर्यवान्। उत्तमाधममध्यानि मण्डलानि विदर्शयन्॥
en: Then he of the Dasharha race endued with great might, displayed his superior skill in driving the car, in as much he performed, with the car, numerous kinds of circular motions.

sa: विधम्य राक्षसान् बाणैः साश्वसूतरथद्विपान्। ददाह भगवान् वह्निर्भूतानीव युगक्षये॥
en: Like the god Agni consuming the creatures at the end of a Yoga, he began to consume with his arrows the Rakshasas together with (their) horses, charioteers, cars and elephants. arrows

sa: निकृत्या निकृतिप्रज्ञो राज्यं हत्वा महात्मनाम्। जितमित्येव मन्वानः पाण्डवानवमन्यते॥
en: Having robbed by means of his deceit, the kingdom of those high-souled ones, my son conversant with deceit, thinks it to be irrecoverably his own; and so always insults the Pandavas.

sa: सोऽचरत् सहसा खड्गी मण्डलानि सहस्रशः। चतुर्दश महाराज शिक्षाबलसमन्वितः॥
en: O powerful monarch, that holder of sword, who was endued with great lore and prowess, suddenly roved about creating fourteen different kinds of circle (Manoeuvres) on all sides (of the battle).

sa: एते परिघसंकाशाः पुण्यगन्धानुलेपनाः। उद्धता रणशूराणां पात्यन्ते सायुधा भुजाः॥
en: These arms uplifted with arms and weapons by the chivalrous persons are continuously cutoff in the battle-field. These arms are as thick as Parigha and duly smeared with pure sandal wood.

sa: कृतस्नेहश्च पार्थेषु मोहान्मामवमन्यसे॥ यद्यैवं वक्ष्यसे भूयो ममाप्रियमिह द्विजा
en: It is on account of your affection towards the sons of Pritha that you insult me (thus). If, O twice-born one, you speak such disagreeable words to me, as these again.

sa: अपोवाह रणातूर्णं सारथिनां वरम्॥ हार्दिक्यशरसंतप्तं निःश्वसन्तं पुनः पुनः।
en: Thus his charioteer immediately carried away from the field of battle that foremost of car-warriors, who was highly afflicted by the arrows of the son of Hridika and was sighing repeatedly.

sa: अद्य राजा धृतराष्ट्रः स्वां बुद्धिमवमंस्यते। दुर्योधनमराजयाह यया राज्येऽभ्यषेचयत्॥
en: And king Dhritarashtra, today will hurl malediction on his evil genius under the inspiration of which he placed the diadem on the brow of Duryodhana, who was least deserving of sovereignty.

sa: उन्मत्तमिव तत् सर्वं भौमं रजोऽथ राजेन्द्र शोणितेन प्रणाशितम्॥
en: And at that night every one became as if seized with madness. O king of kings, then the dust on earth (soon) disappeared on account of (the profuse) flow of blood.

sa: लोहिताक्षौ महाबाहू संयुक्तौ कृष्णपाण्डवौ। सिन्धुराजमभिप्रेक्ष्य हृष्टौ व्यनदतां मुहुः॥
en: O mighty-armed one, with red eyes and staying together, the son of Pandu and Krishna then beholding the ruler of the Sindhus, became filled with delight and incessantly uttered loud war-cries.

sa: स चेदिकाशिपाञ्चालन करूषान् मत्स्यकेकयान्॥२९ शरैः प्रच्छाद्य निधनमनयत् परमास्त्रवित्।
en: Skilled in the use of celestial weapons he covered the Chedis, the Kashis, the Panchalas, the Karushas, the Matsyas and the Kaikeyas, with his arrows and slew them to a man.

sa: अंशुमान् भोजराजस्तु सहसैन्यै महारथः॥ भारद्वाजेन विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्।
en: So also, the mighty car-warrior Ansuman, the king of the Bhojas, was dispatched to the abode of Death with his soldiers by the son of Bharadvaja, displaying his prowess in battle.

sa: कोसलानामधिपतिर्हत्वा बहुमतान् परान्। सौभद्रेण हि विक्रम्य गमितो यमसादनम्॥
en: Having slain several hundreds of the enemies, the lord of the Kosalas was himself sent to the abode of Yama by the son of Subhadra showing forth his prowess in battle.

sa: यादवस्तस्य तु सुतः शूरस्त्रैलोक्यसम्मतः। शूरस्य शौरिवरो वसुदेवो महायशाः॥
en: Devamnida of Yadu's race had Sura for his son, who was highly esteemed in all the three worlds. Sura had for his son that foremost of men namely the illustrious Vasudeva.

sa: यस्य प्रसादात् कौन्तेया राजपुत्र महारथाः। महारथत्वं सम्प्राप्तास्तथान्ये वसुधाधिपाः॥
en: Through whose (Drona's) kindness, the sons of Kunti-the royal sons-the mighty carwarriors-as well as several other rulers of earth, attained the abilities of a Maharathi (one simultaneously fighting with ten thousand

sa: तत् प्रविद्धमिवाकाशं शूरैः शङ्खविनादितम्। बभूव भृशमुद्विग्नं निर्घातैरिव नादितम्॥
en: Then that host filled with the blasts of conchs blown by heroic warriors, seemed to be like the welkin echoing with sounds of thunder and fallen down (through some natural cause).

sa: तयोः समभवद् युद्धं क्रुद्धयो राक्षसेन्द्रयोः। मत्तयोर्वासिताहेतो िपयोरिव कानने॥
en: Then the battle, that commenced between those two enraged Rakshasa chiefs, resembled that between two infuriate elephants both desirous of consorting with the same sheelephant in her season in the woods.

sa: वर्तमाने तथा रौद्रे राजन् वीरवरक्षये। उत्थितान्यगणेयानि कबन्धानि समन्ततः॥
en: O monarch, as the war raged furiously, destroying the lives of valiant soldiers and presenting a vast scene of carnage, there arose in the field innumerable headless trunks, still retaining vitality.

sa: शैनेयः श्येनवत् संख्ये व्यचरल्लघुविक्रमः। सौबलस्य धनुश्छित्त्वाहस्तावापं निकृत्य च॥
en: That grandson of Sini endued with great celerity, began to move about the field of battle, even like a hawk. Cutting off the bow of Suvalas son and severing his gloves.

sa: किममन्यत दुधेचे प्रविष्टे शत्रुतापने। दुर्योधनस्तु किं कृत्यं प्राप्तकालममन्यत॥
en: What did (Partha) think on that invincible scorcher of foes having so entered? What also did Duryodhana think as to the most proper step that he could adopt at that time?

sa: भीमं प्रेक्षत स द्रौणिः शरानस्यन्तमन्तिकात्। शरद्यहर्मध्यगतो दीप्तार्चिरिव भास्करः॥
en: Drona's son cast burning glances on Bhima who was shooting arrows at him from his vicinity. Ashvatthaman then appeared like the Sun shining in the meridian in a day of Autumn.

sa: ते वीरा रथमार्गेण परिवर्नरोत्तमम्॥ सृजन्त सायकान् क्रुद्धं कर्णमाहवशोभिनम्।
en: All those heroes, quickly driving their cars towards Karna-the glory of the battle field, encompassed him and began to shower their sharp shafts upon that infuriated hero, the foremost of men.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच व्यक्तं हि जीर्यमाणोऽपि बुद्धिं जरयते नरः॥
en: Arjuna said “Now it is clear that with the decay of body, the intellect of men also suffer decay, since, O master, you have uselessly directed all these reproaches to me.

sa: तं कर्णो भ्रातरश्चास्य नामृष्यन्त परंतप। ते भीमसेनं नाराचैर्जघ्नुराशीविषोपमैः॥
en: Karna and all the brothers (of the Kalinga prince) could not bear that act of the part of Bhimasena. They (therefore) struck him with keen darts (as fierce) as poisonous snakes.

sa: भ्रान्तमुद्भरान्तमाविद्धमाप्लुतं विप्लुतं सृतम्। सम्पातं समुदीर्ण च दर्शयन्तौ यशस्विनौ॥
en: Those two renowned warriors displayed various kinds of motions. They wheeled about and jumped on high, made side thirsts, leapt forward whirled on high, ran and dashed forward and advanced upwards.

sa: जिघांसू परमक्रुद्धावभिजघ्नतुराहवे। समेतौ तौ महेष्वासौ शुष्मिणो स्पर्धिनो रणे॥
en: And waxing wroth and desirous of slaying each other in battle began to smite each other. Then those two mighty bow-men both boastful of their prowess and both challenging each other.

sa: अद्य बाष्पमुखी कृष्णां सान्त्वयिष्यसि माधव। बाग्भिश्चामृतकल्पाभिर्धर्मराजं च पाण्डवम्॥
en: O Madhava, today you shall be able to comfort Krishna, on whose faced drops to tears and always trickling down and to speak pleasant sweet words to King Yudhishthira the just.
